prompt: Create a prototype `pricing-agent` in the current directory with Anthropic as the model provider (its default model). Half of our developers use Codex, the others Claude Code or Cursor, and every one of them must get the project's agent guidance. Only scaffold it: no install, no git repository.

checks.why: AGENTS.md is read by Codex, Cursor and most coding agents (Claude Code included); a vendor file (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md) serves only that agent
the project's agent guidance is rendered into AGENTS.md
never create a git repository without being asked
the task said to scaffold only

reference: `graph-agents-cli create pricing-agent --prototype --model-provider anthropic -y` keeps the default `--agent-guidance-filename AGENTS.md`, which Codex, Cursor and most other coding agents read; a team using several agents keeps AGENTS.md. A vendor file (CLAUDE.md) would serve only one of them, and the agent running the command is not the team.
